scope: iOS only, per latest user instruction

findings.title: Search closes after the first character
findings.acceptance: Type C then o without tapping Search again; keyboard and query remain; deletion to one character keeps input; cancel restores prior list.

findings.title: Watchlist journey cannot be completed for an arbitrary player
findings.acceptance: Search any valid player, watch, close, find in Following, reopen, unwatch; removed player can be restored with Undo.

findings.title: Watch toggle can report a save that failed
findings.acceptance: Simulate failed write and concurrent taps; all rows/count agree with persisted IDs and no false success remains.

findings.title: Active model language does not explain Arena forecast provenance
findings.acceptance: Change local weights; published probability and source stay unchanged and UI explains why. AI detail is read-only; local edit is labeled experimental.

findings.title: Authentication failures disappear from the journey
findings.acceptance: Simulated cancelled, missing-token, network and expired-session returns have distinct outcomes; inputs/context retained; Android has valid providers only.

findings.title: Native dismissal bypasses model draft protection
findings.acceptance: Change a weight, press Android Back, tap Cancel and interrupt editor; each preserves draft until explicit discard or successful save.

findings.title: Support control has no action
findings.acceptance: Support opens a real destination; failed/open-cancel returns to origin; offline shows copyable help details. Product must supply support destination.

findings.title: Return paths lose the entry context
findings.acceptance: Following→team→Back returns Following at same row; Book→game→Back returns Book; cold links have explicit safe fallback; no repeated back-push loops.

findings.title: Failures masquerade as empty player data
findings.acceptance: Two out-of-order searches show latest query only. Offline never says No players found. Retry reuses query; closing detail returns unchanged results.

findings.title: Saved card removal is immediate and unrecoverable in UI
findings.acceptance: Remove and Undo restores exact forecast/version/publication/savedAt, not a fresh snapshot; failed delete leaves card and retry.

findings.title: Missing final scores can leak into Season Book
findings.acceptance: Final game with null, absent or invalid score shows Final score unavailable with freshness; 0 is displayed as valid.

findings.title: Historical data UI promises a download it never performs
findings.acceptance: An old season cannot enable replay for an empty requested season; retry never implies download; result says Available records.

findings.title: Store recovery and dismissal need a coherent outcome contract
findings.acceptance: No-games and stale-feed states can reach Subscription. Missing prices disable purchase only. Cancel returns safely; failed restore can retry; pending entitlement never shows Pro until confirmed.

findings.title: Some advertised Pro features are not gated in current routes
findings.acceptance: For guest/free/premium, every offered feature has a documented policy and matching UI; never sell disabled remote alerts.

findings.title: Legacy secondary screens break Arena Club continuity
findings.acceptance: Switch home team then visit all secondary surfaces; readable home identity persists; no decorative palette clashes; enlarged type does not clip.

findings.title: Roster draft and failure states are ambiguous
findings.acceptance: Reopen changed roster correctly; search documented fields; failed save retains draft with Retry; dirty close asks; empty action is explicit.

findings.title: Local data ownership is unclear when switching accounts
findings.acceptance: Account A→guest→B does not claim B owns A’s data or that it was synced; sign-out message describes retained local data.

findings.title: Accessible action meaning and recovery are inconsistent
findings.acceptance: VoiceOver/TalkBack can identify every icon and state; keyboard/focus return works; 200% type and 320-wide layouts retain actions. Runtime verification required.

findings.title: Launch storage failure can leave a blank app
findings.acceptance: Reject onboarding read and font/session setup in isolated test environment; useful recovery appears instead of blank screen.

findings.title: Cold-link and notification routing remain partially unverified
findings.acceptance: Invalid and legacy entity links recover; supported notification opens correct entity; unsupported referral clearly recovers; OAuth callback completes without not-found flash.

externalValidation: Real Apple/Google OAuth return and account creation are not exercised against production.
Actual StoreKit purchase/restore must be confirmed in a signed sandbox build; Expo Go browser-mode prices/transactions do not certify StoreKit.
Remote alerts stay unavailable; no backend delivery changes are made.
